proposal.title: Convert SSG General Ledger client-server package to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: SSG General Ledger client-server package
before.description: SSG’s General Ledger client/server package combines an Artemis PRO/AIONix server with AIONix and CP/M clients. Thin clients submit bounded ledger operations; queries, validation, journal posting and durable transactions execute on the server. Authentication, locking, backup and crash-recovery qualification govern supported configurations. SSG retains application ownership, licences, sales and specialist support. AION’s separately scoped engineering work ends with acceptance, maintainer training and source/build handover. The package supplies the three implementation editions and existing licence/packaging items; no new per-seat licensing policy or additional accounting modules are implied.

specification.description: SSG retains its independent application ownership, licensing and specialist support.
Client edition for supported ERA/AIONix systems.
Server edition for the Artemis PRO application/database service.
CP/M client edition for supported Z80 systems.
The existing package includes this document; it does not itself define new licensing rights or seat counts.
Preserves the physical packaging item in the existing package definition.
Defines SSG independence and the AION/Logix development, distribution and support relationship.
